cause: The bare-column scan no longer counts a SubqueryResult expression as a saved local column. EXISTS initialization must depend on ungrouped aggregation instead of that scan. Expressions that also contain aggregate calls need the same initialization.
before: Two existing SQL tests and the added mixed-expression case returned NULL instead of initialized boolean values.
scope: Restores initialization for loop-evaluated EXISTS on empty aggregate inputs. General scheduling of aggregate output subqueries remains part of the outstanding migration.
source: Tests ran on the combined compound-lowering worktree, including separate deferred UPDATE FROM edits. This focused fix excludes those changes.
